description: Search Indian regulatory publications: circulars, orders, notices and press releases from named government regulators. Not case law, statute text or commentary. Capture began 2026-08-23, so an empty result for an earlier date does not mean nothing was published. Not an in-force view. Filters are lists. Pass nextCursor back unchanged while hasMore is true. total null means not measured; 0 means none. Cost: 1 credit.

cursor.description: Opaque. Pass back exactly the nextCursor of the previous page. Do not parse, edit or construct one.

docType.description: Document types as returned in results. A list of separate values.

facets.description: True to also return the filter values available.

id.description: Fetch these document ids in one call, instead of searching.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 100. Omit to use the default.

publishedFrom.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD, as the publisher dated it.

publishedTo.description: ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD, as the publisher dated it.

publisherId.description: Publisher ids, e.g. ['sebi', 'rbi']. A list of separate values, never one comma-joined string.

q.description: Words to search for. Omit to list by filters alone.

sort.description: Order of results. Omit for the default.

sourceId.description: Source ids (a publisher's sub-sources, as get_regulatory_coverage lists them). A list of separate values, never comma-joined.

name: search_regulatory_documents
title: Search Indian Regulatory Documents
